## Grammar class

> This API is provided as a beta preview for developers and may change based on feedback that we receive. Do not use this API in a production environment.
> 

Turns dialect-neutral blueprints into SQL.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare abstract class Grammar 
```

## Remarks

Subclasses supply the parts that genuinely differ between databases — type names, identifier quoting, auto-increment syntax — while the structure of a `CREATE TABLE` is shared here. [grammarFor()](./database.grammarfor.md) returns the built-in implementation for a dialect.

Grammars are stateless and cheap to construct, and every `compile*` method is pure: it returns SQL strings and touches no connection.

This is the package's extension point for supporting a database it does not ship, and is `@beta` because the protected surface subclasses build on will keep growing as the builder learns more column modifiers.
